title: RAUM 2022
subtitle: Mainz
content:
After RAUM took place for the first time in 2018, over 150 people from multitude creative disciplines and different age groups came together this weekend. In addition to a cinema program with fiction films, animation shorts and documentaries, there were live concerts, lectures and performances.
